test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some flowers are chemicals.

2. Some chemicals are herbs.

**Conclusions:**

I. No flower is a herb.

II. Some flowers are herbs.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59ad67883b02e87e11bf512ab79e9a86b02a92479e449fdd2d6d30f24db52dff.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No flower is a herb. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between flower and herb. Hence, false)

II. Some flowers are herbs. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between flower and herb. Hence, false)

Conclusion I and II are complementary statements. 

Therefore, either I or II follows.

Hence,** Either conclusion I or II follows**.
